answer: Escrow releases when a task passes, and every failure is published with the task id, the grader set and the hash, so a farm that fails 900 of 1,000 tasks leaves a public trail that costs it future work. Trust attaches to a task, not an address, so 1,000 clones share one thin reputation. Edge case: a clone that passes 1 hard task and fails 99 cheap ones still nets 0.01 of a bond. The beacon stamps the publication, the timber of the ledger keeps it, and the garden of past failures is what a buyer reads.
